raw_segments.text: Player Queen, so many journeys may the sun and moon make us again count o'er e'er
love be done, but woe is me you are so sick of late, so far from cheer and from your former
Yet though I distrust, discomfort you, my lord, it nothing must, for women's fear and
love holds quantity in neither ought or in extremity.
Now what my love is, proof hath made you know, and as my love is sizzed my fear is so.
Where love is great, the littlest doubts are fear.
Where little fears grow great, great love grows there.
